articles.summary: Off-the-plan (OTP) purchasing has its critics, but in a tight rental market with strong yields, many investors are rediscovering the advantages: tax depreciation, modern specs, stamp duty savings, and time to build equity before settlement.
articles.title: Off‑the‑Plan Apartments: Risk, Reward, and How to Do It Right

articles.summary: Perth’s booming population growth and record-low vacancy rates have created exceptional conditions for apartment investors – if they can find an apartment to buy.
articles.title: Supply crisis turns Perth apartments into investment winners
